title: The builder-diff guard counts test paths against MERGE_HEAD, not HEAD, at the commit that makes a merge commit
why: At a merge commit, the builder-diff guard counts test paths against HEAD while MERGE_HEAD is set, so the files the merge brings in read as the builder's own test edits. Live case: MERGE_HEAD e2703c611, HEAD ddeebc925, 40 staged test paths (lane tier-boundaries-enforced, session_013NEJKzVTWMbokJ3KFanBBC; coordinator, 03:56 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: when MERGE_HEAD is set, the guard counts only the paths the builder changed beyond the merge's own result (the diff against MERGE_HEAD and HEAD both), so a merge's incoming test files do not count as test edits. Red case first: a merge commit that brings in test files from main is refused today; control: a builder test edit in the same merge still refuses. Built in lane tier-boundaries-enforced as a follow-up guard fix. Related step tier-boundaries-enforced. The records-page finding of that lane is dropped: the commit held conflict markers, so its refusal was right. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 03:59 CST Nov 8.
